description: Discover what's trending/going viral across TikTok, Instagram, X, Facebook, Pinterest, Bluesky, Douyin, Reddit, Mastodon, Tumblr, Hacker News and news RSS, learn the best time to post on each network from measured viral posts, find the top hashtags, trending sounds and best communities, make on-brand images from the organization's templates, leave complete posts as drafts for a person to review (or review them yourself), translate a post into a linked project's language, and schedule or publish posts to the user's own connected social accounts — powered by the ViralHunt.io API. Use this when the user has a ViralHunt account or token (or wants one) and asks to find viral or trending content in a niche through ViralHunt, to research what is performing on social right now, to know when or where to post, to run a standing content job for a brand, to check or review ViralHunt drafts, or to draft, schedule or publish social posts through their ViralHunt-connected accounts. Do not use it for social media advice that needs no data, for operating a social network's own app or API directly, or for other scheduling tools.

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent validate API outcomes instead of assuming success?
Did the agent preserve evidence for request/response behavior and error handling?
